baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.parameter: converter architecture and storage-to-converter electrical interface
baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.old_value: CONDITIONAL 2-cell/phase CHB using 4.5 kV-class semiconductors and 2.0-2.5 kV/cell DC bus
baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.new_value: ACCEPTED 4-cell/phase CHB using 1.7 kV / 3.6 kA-class single IGBT modules and 1.0-1.1 kV/cell DC bus
baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.reason: Targeted PWM, semiconductor-current, 1.5 s transient-thermal and DC-link RLC screening showed adequate voltage synthesis, single-device current margin and controllable local DC-link ripple with lower-voltage high-current IGBTs.
evidence: At 1.0 kV/cell the present ~4.066 kV motor reference requires modulation index about 0.83; the 4.5 kV converter class requires about 0.919.
At the 2.345 kA RMS normal point, worst single IGBT RMS/peak current is about 1.46/3.32 kA.
At the 3.5 kA RMS design envelope, worst single IGBT RMS/peak current is about 2.18/4.95 kA; 1.5 s screening delta-Tj-c is about 29 K.
With 50 mF local DC link, 10 mOhm source resistance and 3 uH feed inductance, 3.5 kA screening gives about 999 V minimum DC link and 67.9 Vpp ripple.
Increasing film capacitance cannot compensate excessive source ESR; source equivalent resistance therefore becomes a hard storage-interface requirement.
downstream_impact: supercapacitor branch voltage changes from 2.0-2.5 kV to 1.0-1.1 kV per H-bridge
H-bridge count changes from 6 to 12 per three-phase converter
IGBT module count becomes 48 per three-phase converter / 144 across three longitudinal converter groups
per-cell average power halves to approximately 1 MW while each cell still carries full phase current
DC-link film capacitor bank, storage branch ESR/ESL, precharge, protection and cabinet count must be redesigned for 36 floating H-bridge cells
insulation/common-mode behavior changes because the number of cascaded cells doubles and per-cell dv/dt voltage step decreases
baseline_change_20260923_converter_1p7kV.recommendation: FROZEN architecture; detailed hardware parameters remain conditional where explicitly marked
